Indoor Air Quality Services in Columbia, SC

Columbia homes run sealed for most of the year: closed against the heat and humidity all summer, closed against the cold in winter. Whatever is in the air stays in the air, and this market adds plenty. Spring coats the region in pine pollen, and summer humidity feeds mold and dust mites indoors. 2nd Wind Heating & Air Conditioning provides indoor air quality services across the Midlands that address the three variables that decide what you breathe: how air moves, what it carries, and how much moisture it holds.

Air quality complaints are diagnosable, so we treat them the way we treat equipment failures. Musty smells, dust that returns a day after cleaning, allergy symptoms that ease when you leave the house, and rooms that feel damp each point to specific causes in the ducts, the humidity, or the filtration. The technician inspects, records video of what they find, whether that is a disconnected duct in the crawl space or condensation where it should not be, and prices the fix before any work begins. Air quality equipment also gets checked during Cloud 10 visits on our maintenance plans.

Schedule an indoor air quality inspection with 2nd Wind by phone, online, or 24/7 chat, and see the cause on video before you choose the fix.

Air Ducts

Ductwork is the delivery system for every conditioned cubic foot of air in the house, and leaks or contamination there affect every room at once. Our air duct services cover inspection, sealing, repair, and cleaning.

Air Scrubbers

Filtration catches what happens to pass through the filter. Our air scrubber services install in-duct units that treat the air actively as the system circulates it, which suits households dealing with allergies, odors, or pets.

Dehumidifiers

Half of Midlands comfort is moisture control. Our whole-home dehumidifier services hold indoor humidity in the healthy range, protecting the house and taking load off the air conditioner.

Humidifiers

Winter heating dries indoor air below the comfortable range, which shows up as static, dry skin, and shrinking wood floors. Our whole-home humidifier services add moisture back in controlled amounts.

Dryer Vent Cleaning

A clogged dryer vent wastes energy on every load and creates a documented fire risk. Our dryer vent cleaning services clear the full run from the dryer to the exterior termination.
